exposure: heritable fibrillinopathies (HF: MFS, EDS, LDS, FTAAS)
CTD with aortic dilatation (TOF, d-TGA, DORV)
cohort: 73 pregnant women with aortopathy or aortic enlargement in conotruncal defects between 2000 and 2013
finding: The study found a substantial incidence of MAMCRE in pregnant women with aortopathy, particularly among those with higher pre-pregnancy CSA/Ht ratios, and higher rates of C-section and PPH compared to the general population.
mod_finding: Overall and emergent C-section rates were higher in the study cohort than the general population.
